name: qdq_wr_ref-q8e-COMMIT
purpose: QDQ B2 quarter q8b (coordinator option B after q7 EARLY_FAIL: 14.3k cluster flops on a spine that diverged to 1.79 ns): one of four face-anchored M5 leaves under the wires-only ot_hgi_qdq_q, a flop at every pin; composition bench = the production QDQ bench on the B2 slice (183 cycles vs 168 priced, 1.089x) built from this commit. ot_hgi_qdq_wr: result FIFO on one 64x512 SRAM macro behind a 2-entry registered prefetch (ESL 128), y pin flops, write issue on 8 lanes (wwq 2,240 output flops), write credits, snapshot FIFO + finish pulse (5.2k flops + SRAM); at the cluster N face under the wwq pins, y enters on S above the dxl|dbq channel.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_qdq_wr u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/link/ot_fifo_sram_fwft.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/qw/ot_hgi_qdq_wr.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: production_qdq_m0
bench.cmd: S=3 MUT=0 QDQ_G='-GSPANPIPE=1 -GPIN4=1' bash tools/hgi_unit_tput/run_qdq_case.sh results/rtl/tput_map_1011/ds_qdq_b2/lq_pair_vectors {RUN}/qdq_m0 && grep -q 'cycles=183 priced=168 S=3' {RUN}/qdq_m0/run.log

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qdq_wr_ref/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qdq_wr_ref/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qdq_wr_ref --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_qdq_wr --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: q8d routed TT -112.55 FF -2.32 DRC6: sh->sh 22 levels and metadata->FIFO/head 21-25 levels at SS. Independent kept FIFO head reads and masked data selection place pop/fin after each read mux; two parallel completion subtracts move done-bit select after carry, preserving transaction and cycle timing. Same clock spine and exact boundary.
